story.what_it_does: Muthoot Finance is India's largest gold loan lender, lending money against gold jewellery kept as security. It held about 196 tonnes of gold as security in FY2025-26 and had a 47% share of the gold loan NBFC market. It also has smaller subsidiaries in home loans, microfinance (Belstar) and Muthoot Money.
story.plans: Management guided to about 15% AUM growth for Q1 FY27 and about 200 new branches at Muthoot Finance in FY27, plus 200 gold branches at Belstar. In the Sep-26 press release it said it was raising its FY27 gold loan growth guidance by a further 10% but gave no exact figure. It also proposes to merge Muthoot Money into Muthoot Finance from April 1, 2027, subject to approvals.
story.moat: Its scale is the main strength: the largest gold loan book (₹1,628,260 million standalone at March 2026) and about 2,00,000 customers served per day. Gold security keeps losses low, with bad debts written off at 0.14% of loans in FY2026. Competition from banks and other NBFCs expanding in gold lending could pressure margins, per the notes.

scenarios.story: Gold loan growth stays strong, with the loan book about 42% higher in Sep-26 and guidance raised, while profit keeps growing. Gold security and a healthy capital cushion above the 15% requirement let it absorb stress.
signals_to_watch: Whether FY27 gold loan growth guidance is raised again with a clear number
Whether capital adequacy stays near or above 19.81% as the book grows

scenarios.story: Growth slows from the 50% pace to the 40s as the book gets bigger, and margins ease slightly, as shown by net interest margin of 11.93% in Q2 FY27 versus 12.66% a year earlier. Profit still grows, but more slowly than the record FY26 jump of 95%.
signals_to_watch: Net interest margin trend after 11.93% in Q2 FY27
Year-on-year loan AUM growth versus 42% in Sep-26

scenarios.story: Asset quality worsens: bad loans (Stage III) jumped from 2.28% in Jun-26 to 3.87% in Sep-26, and Stage II loans rose sharply. The gold margin of safety fell to 35% from 53%, which leaves less protection if gold prices fall.
signals_to_watch: Gross Stage III ratio after 3.87% in Sep-26
Stage II loan assets, which jumped to ₹234,667 Mn in Sep-26
